name: crew-graph
description: Live agent dashboard with Clawd crabs: model vitals, permission gate, architect, subagent cards, the agent tree and plan/doc graph, and a three.js 3D view of agents interacting, in the pane (/crew 3d) or the browser (/crew web). Absorbs Flightdeck

foodFrom.title: Food from
foodFrom.description: What the characters eat. auto: the agents' to-do lists, plus each prompt you send when this session has no task tools (TodoWrite, TaskCreate); todos: just the to-do lists; todos+work: the lists and each prompt you send. Subagent tickets are always food

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the agent types and server tools that count as the on-call architect, e.g. advisor|architect|reviewer

architectLabel.title: Architect label
architectLabel.description: Name shown for the architect role

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission panel

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: 3d, main, crew, architect, gate, agents, loops, receipt, log. Leave one out to hide it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

moments.title: Architect moments
moments.description: Show the inferred moment of each consult (before a plan, error repeats, before done)

matchDescriptions.title: Match agent descriptions
matchDescriptions.description: Also count an agent type as the architect when its description (not just its name) matches the pattern

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: a summary of at most 8 rows when the pane sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show context, agents, consults and denials in the status line

webOnStart.title: Web view on start
webOnStart.description: Start writing the 3D browser view data (~/.claude/crew-graph/data.js) when a session starts; /crew web does it on demand

petOnStart.title: Desktop pet on start
petOnStart.description: Start the desktop pet (a transparent window with the crabs) when a session starts; /crew pet does it on demand. The first start downloads Electron (about 100 MB)

view3dFps.title: 3D view frame rate
view3dFps.description: Frames per second of the in-pane 3D view while you interact with it (1-20); idle it drops to 4

view3dColumns.title: 3D view pane width
view3dColumns.description: Columns the pane asks for when /crew 3d opens it (40-240)

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Who is drawn as which character: who=character pairs, e.g. main=crab, Explore=bunny, sonnet-coder=robot, *=auto (who: an agent id or type, architect, or a prefix ending in *; character: crab, bunny, cat, mochi, robot, one of yours in ~/.claude/crew-graph/characters/, random for a stable pick, or auto to match the agent's role to a character's traits). A part without = means *=, so auto alone works. Empty: every agent is a crab. The desktop pet's Settings window sets characters too and wins over this. /crew characters lists them

view3dMode.title: 3D view drawing
view3dMode.description: auto: real pixels on kitty/Ghostty, colour blocks (2x2 pixels a cell) elsewhere
